content.subject: Quick thought on month‑end close
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,
ShipMonk officially announced Devin Weil as CFO. Month‑end close likely drags because matching remains manual and complex across systems, forcing the team to reconcile line‑by‑line.
We build a reconciliation engine that pulls data from each system, normalizes formats, and matches entries automatically.
Could we schedule a brief 15‑minute call next week to explore whether this approach fits your workflow?
